sample.comment: An action performed by a direct agent and indirect participants upon a direct object. Optionally happens at a location with the help of an inanimate instrument. The execution of the action may produce a result. Specific action sub-type documentation specifies the exact expectation of each argument/role.\n\nSee also [blog post](https://blog.schema.org/2014/04/16/announcing-schema-org-actions/) and [Actions overview document](https://schema.org/docs/actions.html).
sample.label: Action

sample.comment: An article, such as a news article or piece of investigative report. Newspapers and magazines have articles of many different types and this is intended to cover them all.\n\nSee also [blog post](https://blog.schema.org/2014/09/02/schema-org-support-for-bibliographic-relationships-and-periodicals/).
sample.label: Article

sample.comment: The most generic kind of creative work, including books, movies, photographs, software programs, etc.
sample.label: CreativeWork

sample.comment: An event happening at a certain time and location, such as a concert, lecture, or festival. Ticketing information may be added via the [[offers]] property. Repeated events may be structured as separate Event objects.
sample.label: Event

sample.comment: A utility class that serves as the umbrella for a number of 'intangible' things such as quantities, structured values, etc.
sample.label: Intangible

sample.comment: An organization such as a school, NGO, corporation, club, etc.
sample.label: Organization

sample.comment: A person (alive, dead, undead, or fictional).
sample.label: Person

sample.comment: Entities that have a somewhat fixed, physical extension.
sample.label: Place

sample.comment: Any offered product or service. For example: a pair of shoes; a concert ticket; the rental of a car; a haircut; or an episode of a TV show streamed online.
sample.label: Product

sample.comment: The most generic type of item.
sample.label: Thing
